Name: Ridgeside Forage Wild Seeds
Author: Arrowhawkmods
Description:
Ever felt like you never find the forage you need? Do the mods that adds the seeds directly not tickle you fancy?
Then this mod is perfect for you, make wild seeds like you can in the base game for that nice balanced gameplay you know you love!
[list]
[*]Adds four crafting recipies for seasonal seeds that will grow into the forageable Items found in the Ridgeside village. [/*]
[*]The recipies unlock at the same time the normal wild seeds unlock: Spring seed at forage lvl 1, summer seeds at foraging lvl 4, Fall seeds at foraging lvl 6 and winter seeds at foraging lvl 7.[/*]
[*]The resulting forage will be affected by forage mastery[/*]
[*]Made with Content Patcher and the mod from Kronosta [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21514]Forage Crops[/url][/*]
[/list]

Any tips and comments would be very helpful and I will try my best to adress any issues, but I'm not a coder and this is my first ever attempt at any sort of modding!
